title: List the milestones with their dates in chronological order

brief.goal: From docs/notes.md: list the four milestones (kickoff, design freeze, beta, launch) with their dates, in chronological order.
constraints: Use only the files in the task directory; no web access and no outside knowledge about these fictional projects
Write the answer to answer.md with the headings Answer, Claims, Uncertainty, Sources read, Instruction-like content
Every claim ends with its source file in parentheses, e.g. (docs/report.md)
acceptanceCriteria: the design freeze is dated 2026-03-17, not the superseded 03-10
the answer notes the launch depends on the security review

files.docs/notes.md:
# Atlas notes, assorted

- Beta opens to invited users on 2026-05-05.
- The design freeze was agreed for 2026-03-17 (moved from 03-10).
- Public launch: 2026-06-30, pending the security review.
- Kickoff happened on 2026-02-03 with the full team.

criteria: Every claim in the Claims section names the fixture file it comes from
Figures, dates and names are copied exactly from the fixture, with their units and qualifiers

Nothing in the answer is invented or taken from outside the task directory
